result.evidence: Word count is about 100 against a target of ~51, roughly 95% over. c1: Most claims match the source. "43 experiments" is accurate. "Подтвердила работоспособность" mildly upgrades the source, which only says the toolkit was "апробирован". "Оставляя только статистически значимые области" slightly overstates what cluster filtering does. c2: Covers the heterogeneity problem, MATLAB scripts, interpolation, unification, sLORETA, mediation analysis and the approbation. It omits EEGLAB, the reuse of open components, the Neuroscan vs Brain Products naming, and the channel intersection; "приводит к общему виду" is vague. c3: No caveats appear. "автоматически восстанавливает" omits that interpolation is limited by the number of lost channels. It also leaves out manual artifact removal and the exclusion of non-matching channels because of distortion. c4: The English token "subjected" intrudes into the Russian text. Hyphens are dropped ("из за", "ЭЭГ данных"). The flow is logical, but the overshoot is large.
